task: Implement one canonical deterministic production-lineage contract that binds the existing Template Factory recipe/foundation identity, accepted Visual Authority, Template Genome, Constraint Plan, Media Plan and compiled package identity into an immutable hash chain without creating a parallel production authority.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: The Factory report already exposes recipe/foundation/reference/Genome provenance and the proven planning stack now emits deterministic Constraint Plan and Media Plan hashes, but there is no single immutable end-to-end production lineage that binds those inputs to the compiled package identity. Without that chain, later anti-clone and dynamic compiler proof cannot distinguish stale, cross-template or partially recomputed evidence reliably.
observableOutcomes: One versioned immutable lineage contract binds recipe, foundation, accepted Visual Authority, Genome, Constraint Plan, Media Plan and compiled package identity.
Lineage is deterministic: identical canonical inputs and package produce exactly the same lineage hash across runs.
Any semantic input or compiled package mutation changes the lineage hash.
Lineage validation fails closed on missing upstream hashes, template/version drift, stale Visual Authority, media/constraint source mismatch or package identity drift.
Factory report exposes the canonical lineage without writing it into every Page Schema document.
Generator Readiness can surface lineage validity while remaining separate from Product Owner visual acceptance.
No CI run id, timestamp or environment-specific value participates in lineage truth.
Anti-clone and Dynamic Compiler remain separate waves and consume lineage later instead of being implicitly promoted.
unresolvedRisks: Hashing only top-level identities would miss semantic package mutations.
Hashing the full Factory report would capture non-production counters/evidence and make lineage unstable.
Embedding lineage into Page Schema pages would recreate the Genome metadata regression and change canonical package equality.
If Constraint Plan and Media Plan are recomputed independently but their source relation is not checked, lineage could bless mismatched plans.
If concrete package hash is order-sensitive in semantically unordered structures, equivalent packages could receive different identities.

in: Deterministic canonical package identity/hash over the compiled installable package.
Fail-closed lineage validation and source-chain consistency checks.
Factory report provenance integration only, not Page Schema mutation.
Maturity promotion with executable adversarial proof.
out: VX Smart Intent or Smart Auto-Fix.
CI/workflow run identity as production lineage input.
New Control Plane gates or separate lineage completion authority.

assuranceCeiling.rationale: Production lineage becomes the identity spine consumed by later compiler and anti-clone evidence. Highest practical assurance requires deterministic canonical serialization, immutable source bindings, end-to-end source consistency checks, package-hash sensitivity, stale/cross-template rejection and adversarial replay, while keeping operational CI evidence outside production truth.

acceptanceCriteria: Production lineage has one canonical versioned contract under builder-template-system.
Lineage includes recipe identity, foundation identity, Visual Authority reference, Genome hash, Constraint Plan hash, Media Plan hash and compiled package hash.
Compiled package hash is deterministic and changes on meaningful package mutation.
Constraint Plan source Genome hash equals lineage Genome hash and Media Plan source Constraint Plan hash equals lineage Constraint Plan hash.
Lineage identity matches the target recipe and compiled package manifest template key/version.
Factory report exposes lineage while Page Schema and installable package shape remain unchanged.
Generator Readiness fails closed when lineage inputs are inconsistent for a declared Blueprint.
FACTORY-DETERMINISTIC-LINEAGE becomes PROVEN only after implementation plus adversarial executable tests.
FACTORY-DISTINCTNESS-ANTI-CLONE and FACTORY-DYNAMIC-PRODUCTION-COMPILER remain not promoted.
invariants: Constraint Plan remains bounded semantic production constraint authority.
Media Plan remains semantic-to-concrete media planning authority.
Installable package remains Page Schema/package authority; lineage observes it and never mutates it.
Timestamp, CI run ID, branch or Vercel deployment ID are excluded from production lineage hash.
UNKNOWN or missing upstream hash never counts as valid lineage.

failureModes: Package content changes while lineage hash remains unchanged.
Media Plan points to a different Constraint Plan than the lineage chain.
Constraint Plan points to a different Genome hash than the lineage chain.
Recipe identity and compiled package manifest target different template versions.
Visual Authority reference used by Constraint Plan differs from active recipe/reference.
Lineage hash changes between identical runs because timestamps or runtime evidence leak into the contract.
edgeCases: Object key ordering differences must not change package or lineage hash.
Array ordering that is canonical/meaningful must remain hash-significant.
An undeclared Blueprint/recipe may have no valid lineage and must remain generator-not-ready without invented hashes.
Internal-reference versus ready media can change package output and therefore package lineage only when the compiled package actually differs.
Existing exact package equality tests must remain unchanged because lineage lives in report provenance only.

alternatives.summary: Create one read-only canonical lineage spine over proven upstream hashes and compiled package identity.
alternatives.reason: It closes the provenance chain without duplicating any planning or Page Schema authority.
Report contains diagnostics/counters/evidence that are not canonical production inputs and would make lineage unstable.

alternatives.summary: Write lineage metadata into each compiled page document.
alternatives.reason: This would mutate canonical Page Schema/package equality and repeat the previously caught Genome metadata regression.

specialistReviews.finding: The proven upstream stack already emits deterministic hashes; lineage should compose those authorities rather than add another planner.
specialistReviews.resolution: Create a read-only production-lineage module and expose its result in Generator Readiness/Factory report only.

specialistReviews.finding: Top-level identity alone cannot prove the compiled package actually corresponds to upstream plans.
specialistReviews.resolution: Compute a deterministic compiled-package hash and include it in the lineage digest; adversarial package mutation must change the lineage.

specialistReviews.finding: Lineage metadata must not leak into Page Schema and trigger visual/canonical-package regressions.
specialistReviews.resolution: Expose lineage only in Factory report/Generator Readiness evidence surfaces.

specialistReviews.finding: Operational CI/run metadata is useful evidence but is not deterministic production identity.
specialistReviews.resolution: Exclude run IDs, timestamps, branches and deployment URLs from production-lineage canonical input.

challenge.scenario: Two semantically identical package objects are created with different object-key insertion order.
challenge.finding: Naive JSON.stringify hashing can generate different package identities.
challenge.resolution: Use recursive canonical key ordering before deterministic digest.

challenge.scenario: A product page binding is changed after the upstream Genome/Constraint/Media plans remain identical.
challenge.finding: Lineage could falsely report the same production output if package identity is omitted.
challenge.resolution: Compiled package canonical hash is a mandatory lineage source and must change.

challenge.scenario: Media Plan source.constraintPlanHash references an older Constraint Plan while its own hash is otherwise valid.
challenge.finding: Independent valid hashes could form a stale mixed chain.
challenge.resolution: Lineage validation requires exact source-chain equality before hashing.

challenge.scenario: Constraint Plan sources.genomeHash differs from the active Template Genome hash.
challenge.finding: A stale planner output could be attached to a newer template identity.
challenge.resolution: Reject with explicit lineage Genome/Constraint source mismatch.

challenge.scenario: Compiled package manifest templateVersion differs from recipe templateVersion.
challenge.finding: Lineage could bind input version N to output version N-1.
challenge.resolution: Recipe and package manifest identity must match exactly.

challenge.scenario: Developer adds generatedAt or CI run ID into the lineage input for observability.
challenge.finding: Identical production inputs would produce different hashes across runs.
challenge.resolution: Contract has no operational-time/run fields and tests assert deterministic repeatability.

challenge.scenario: Lineage is copied into every Page Schema metadata block.
challenge.finding: Canonical package output changes despite lineage being evidence-only.
challenge.resolution: Factory report owns lineage evidence; package/page documents remain byte-semantically unchanged.

challenge.scenario: One required upstream plan is missing but other identities are present.
challenge.finding: Partial provenance could be mistaken for a complete lineage.
challenge.resolution: Declared generator-ready production requires Genome, valid Constraint Plan and valid Media Plan; missing source returns invalid lineage, never a partial PASS.

proofPlan: Determinism proof: identical inputs/package yield identical package hash and lineage hash across recomputation.
Canonical-order proof: object key insertion differences do not alter lineage identity.
Mutation proof: meaningful package/Genome/Constraint/Media source mutation changes or invalidates lineage.
Cross-source proof: stale Genome→Constraint or Constraint→Media links fail closed.
Generator Readiness proof: canonical Loot Vault lineage is valid and a mismatched lineage input blocks readiness.
Canonical package regression proof confirms report lineage does not alter compiled package/Page Schema.
Maturity proof promotes only deterministic lineage while anti-clone and dynamic compiler remain incomplete.
Normal CI + exact-head Template Factory Quality Gate v2 + Completion Truth + lifecycle closure.

requirements.requirement: Canonical deterministic production lineage binds recipe/foundation/reference/Genome/Constraint Plan/Media Plan and compiled package identity into one immutable validated hash chain.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Lineage observes canonical production authorities and compiled output but does not mutate or replace them.

requirements.requirement: Missing, stale, cross-template or source-mismatched lineage inputs cannot produce a valid lineage or generator-ready result.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Partial or stale lineage evidence cannot be treated as complete production truth.

requirements.requirement: Deterministic lineage completion does not promote cross-template anti-clone or the dynamic production compiler.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Lineage completion cannot imply anti-clone or dynamic compilation is proven.
